description: Chart 06 — Paradox-reveal hero. One point per SA2: socio-economic advantage (SEIFA IRSAD decile, x) against transport access (share of venues within 400 m of a stop, y), coloured teal (metro) / orange (regional). A linear trend line per region makes the Simpson's paradox visible: metro access is flat-and-high (~86%) across every wealth decile, while regional sits far below (~57%). Pooling the two would suggest a wealth gradient that doesn't exist within either group. Receives the choropleth's SA2 highlight in module #5. Data: chart_scatter_sa2.csv.

title.text: Wealth barely moves transport access — once you split metro from regional
title.subtitle: Each dot is an SA2. Metro venues stay ~86% within 400 m of a stop at every decile; regional ones sit near 57%.

x.title: SEIFA IRSAD decile  (1 = most disadvantaged → 10 = most advantaged)

y.title: Venues within 400 m of a stop (%)
